summary: Amass Brands filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 1 to a Warrant with Streeterville Capital, LLC. The amendment temporarily reduces the exercise price to $5.00 per share for 90 days, after which it reverts to $16.00 per share. The company can terminate the reduced-price period early with two days' notice. No other terms change. This is a routine modification of a prior warrant agreement, not a special situation. It involves contractual adjustments to existing financing terms without triggering an acquisition, tender offer, or other special-situation event.
